name: Waitakere City Council
story: Waitākere City Council used MapInfo and MapBasic and integrated GIS with asset management during 1999–2002. It also participated in Auckland regional GIS coordination and worked on MapInfo–Confirm integration.

sources.label: Office of the Auditor-General, GIS and the Auckland Area Orthophotography Standard
Martin Roundill, MapInfo-L message on Waitakere City Council MapInfo/Confirm integration and related MapBasic correspondence
